# Function: isCacheMiss()

> **isCacheMiss**(`value`): `value is CacheMiss`

Narrows a cached value to the miss sentinel.

## Parameters

### value

`unknown`

The value returned by [Cache#get](../interfaces/Cache.md#get).

## Returns

`value is CacheMiss`

Whether the value is the [CacheMiss](../classes/CacheMiss.md) sentinel.
